    def get_chart_locator(self, cardHeaderName, desiredCohort):
        """Hover down the bars of a dashboard chart until the tooltip names `desiredCohort`; return the tooltip text."""
        #find index of cards by passing card-header names
        card_headers = self.page.locator(f"xpath={AllCohortDashboardPage.graphHeader_titles}")
        # Get all header texts as a list
        header_texts = card_headers.all_inner_texts()
        card_index = header_texts.index(cardHeaderName)
        chart = self.page.locator(f"xpath={AllCohortDashboardPage.graphCanvas}[{card_index+1}]")
    
        # The chart keeps animating, so Playwright's "stable element" wait for hover() can time out. Scroll it into
        # view and move the mouse to absolute coordinates instead.
        chart.evaluate("element => element.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'})")
        self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)   # let the chart finish drawing
        box = chart.bounding_box()
        hover_x = box["x"] + box["width"] * 0.6    # x position for hovering over the bars
    
        steps = 30   # the chart can hold many cohorts, so scan its whole height
        for i in range(steps):
            y = box["y"] + box["height"] * (0.05 + 0.9 * i / (steps - 1))
            self.page.mouse.move(hover_x, y)
            self.page.wait_for_timeout(300)
            tooltip = self.page.locator(AllCohortDashboardPage.toolTip_ofGraph_bars)
            #if desired cohort found, return tooltip text
            if tooltip.count() and desiredCohort in tooltip.first.inner_text():
                return tooltip.first.inner_text()
